def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    if h % 2 == 1 and len(set(grid[h // 2])) == 1:
        mid = h // 2
        first, second = grid[:mid], grid[mid + 1:]
    elif w % 2 == 1 and len({row[w // 2] for row in grid}) == 1:
        mid = w // 2
        first = [row[:mid] for row in grid]
        second = [row[mid + 1:] for row in grid]
    else:
        raise ValueError('Expected two equal panels separated by a uniform line')
    shared = set(x for row in first for x in row) & set(x for row in second for x in row)
    common = next(iter(shared))
    return [[3 if a == b else common for a, b in zip(ra, rb)] for ra, rb in zip(first, second)]

for i,(a,b) in enumerate(pairs,1):
 got=transform(a)
 print(i, got==b, len(got),len(got[0]), sorted(set(x for row in got for x in row)), sorted(set(x for row in b for x in row)))
